svg.title: Two cars, floor by tick, in the verification run
svg.desc: Car A, in blue, rises from 0 stopping at 5 and 7, passes 8 without stopping, stops at 9, comes back down to 8 for the down call, then descends to 1. Car B, in violet, comes down from 9 to answer the floor-2 down call and takes that passenger to 0. Thick dots are ticks with the doors open; flags mark when each hall call was pressed.
svg.text: floor by tick: A blue, B violet, dots = doors open
